title: Vericres
extract:
Vericres is a  Tenno Warfan.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Slicing Feathers and  Votive Onslaught stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average block angle (55°)
High follow through (0.7x)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average block angle (55°)
High follow through (0.7x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average block angle (55°)
High follow through (0.7x)
High status chance (28.00%)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average total damage (180)
Below average damage × attack speed (219.6)
Low attack range (1.80 m)
Low status chance (20.00%)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Below average total damage (360)
Below average damage × attack speed (439.2)
Low attack range (1.80 m)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Below average disposition (●●●●○ (1.15x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Below average damage × attack speed (658.8)
Low attack range (1.80 m)
Below average disposition (●●●●○ (1.15x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Vericres is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  200,000 and  410. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

History
Vericres was acquired by watching TennoCon 2022 on WARFRAME's Twitch with a Twitch-linked account for 30 consecutive minutes, between 12:30 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. ET, on July 16th, 2022. The drop included a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Notes
Warfan slam attacks hit twice.
The second hit of a heavy slam will use the stats of a normal slam.

Trivia
This weapon's concept art was designed by Liger Inuzuka.
